correctness.rationale: The 64 possible six-input Boolean contexts of Rule 184 produce exactly the 15 length-four output blocks other than 1100. A second exhaustive 32-context Boolean identity proves that F∘G differs from the central input precisely for contexts 01100,11000,11001,11100, all and only causing a cyclic 1100 occurrence; periodic repeated indices n<4 are allowed. Hence the image language is exactly avoidance and Rule 226 gives an explicit predecessor on it. Since 1100 is unbordered, circular marked-block inclusion-exclusion gives the fixed-weight binomial formula. The deterministic four-state suffix automaton has determinant 1-(1+u)z+u²z^4 and its trace GF is ((1+u)z-4u²z^4)/denominator; u=1 factors into tribonacci and a unit factor. Independently exhausted every cyclic binary configuration for n=1..12, verified the image/right-inverse condition, four local discrepancies, and the GF counts [2,4,8,12,22,40,72,132,242,444,816,1500]. Boolean truth tables and algebra make the unrestricted proof, not the finite enumeration.
